patches.repl:
<script>
/* pages-fixes: a table wider than the screen scrolls sideways, so the scroller must be reachable with the keyboard (axe scrollable-region-focusable) */
document.querySelectorAll('.tablewrap').forEach(function (w) { w.tabIndex = 0; w.setAttribute('role', 'region'); w.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Table (scrolls sideways on narrow screens)'); });
</script>
</body>
patches.note: privacy: the scrollable .tablewrap is keyboard focusable and named; works with and without PG-legal (no-op when the page has no table)
